messages:
Priya (People Ops): Heads up — Anya's birthday + 3-year Redwood anniversary is next Thu (May 2). We'd love to do a low-key hybrid surprise. Quick vote: reply A/B/C/D with your pick
A) Office cupcakes + small desk gifts
B) Care packages mailed to remote folks + Zoom toast
C) Potted plant for her desk + signed card
D) Donate to a charity on her behalf + virtual shoutout
Sign up to help here: https://tiny.redwood/anya-celebrate (please pick one task). I can run the Zoom toast at 3:30pm PT. @here

Zoe: A — cupcakes sound great! I'll do gluten-free ones :cake:

Marcus: B — remote here, care package would be awesome :package:

Lena: D. Love donating — any suggestions for charities? I can set up the page.

Carlos: C — can we get a small succulent? also I'll handle the card and chip in $10.

Anya: no spoilers!!! :pleading_face: (kidding) I'll be OOO that afternoon but can pop in for the Zoom toast if timing works :)

Priya (People Ops): Noted, Anya — we'll keep it a surprise from anyone who shouldn't know. @PeopleOpsBot please create the calendar event and Zoom link.

PeopleOpsBot: Event created — "Anya celebration" • May 2 • 3:30pm PT • Zoom link added • RSVP: 6 so far

Marcus: I'll bring compostable plates + candles. Anyone with nut allergies we should know about?

Zoe: I'm allergic to tree nuts, thanks for asking. I'll label the cupcakes GF + nut-free.

Priya (People Ops): Great — plan so far: Office cupcakes in SF kitchen + care packages mailed to remote. Volunteers: Zoe (GF cupcakes), Carlos (card + $), Marcus (plates/candles), Lena (donation setup). Need 1 more volunteer to handle postage + packing. Please sign up in the doc: https://tiny.redwood/anya-celebrate

Lena: I'll set up the donation page and post details here tomorrow with suggested amounts and the charity link.

Priya (People Ops): Also thinking of a quick 30s montage video from folks — if you have a short clip or photo with Anya, DM it to me or drop in this thread by Tue EOD. :camera_flash:

Anya: ok now you're all on edge, I'll send a few clips — love you guys :heart:

Carlos: Happy to help with postage. I'll also check local courier options for remote packages.

Zoe: :tada: excited!

Priya (People Ops): Thanks everyone — keeping this thread for logistics. I'll post the final checklist and shopping list by Wednesday. :party-parrot:
